content:
Maria G.: Morning — need to swap primary for Sat 03/08. Flight got rescheduled last night. Can AJ take primary from 00:00 UTC Sat -> 00:00 UTC Sun? I can remain as a passive shadow/fallback from home. Paging has been light but oncall-bot showed 3 P1s in the last 7d so want to make sure we have APAC coverage. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/pg-infra-pager

oncall-bot: Automated summary: 3 P1 pages in last 7d, avg MTTR 18m. Active incidents: 0. To request a swap use `/oncall swap-primary @target --from @current --start <unix> --end <unix>`. See https://redwood/runbooks/oncall-swap for guidance.

AJ: I can take primary for that window, but I can't cover APAC overnight on 03/08 (roughly 22:00-06:00 UTC). Need someone to own that chunk or a handover plan.

Samir: I can cover the APAC overnight as secondary if needed, but only as backup — I have a meeting at 03:30 UTC so won't be fully hands-on. @Kevin any chance you can take the APAC midnight block?

Kevin: I can take the APAC block on Sat night (14:00-22:00 PST local, which matches 22:00-06:00 UTC). I work evenings that week, so that slot is fine. Quick question — is the expectation to be primary for that block or shadow?

Maria G.: Ideally APAC is primary for that block. If Kevin is primary, AJ stays overall primary for the 00:00-00:00 UTC day, and Kevin becomes regional primary for the APAC hours. I'll be passive shadow 00:00-06:00 UTC in case something noisy crops up. Please update PagerDuty schedules and the handoff doc: https://docs.redwood.com/handbooks/oncall/handoffs/sat-rotation

Samir: Sounds good. AJ — can you run the swap command and post the output here so ops knows it's scheduled? Also make sure PD notifications go to #oncall-ops and #incidents.

AJ: Will do. Running now.

AJ: Command output:
```
$ oncall-tool swap --primary aj --secondary samir --start 2334568000 --end 2334654400
Swap scheduled: primary=AJ, secondary=Samir, start=2025-03-08T00:00:00Z, end=2025-03-09T00:00:00Z
Notifications sent to: #eng-oncall, #oncall-ops, PagerDuty
```
I also updated the handoff doc with a short checklist and added Kevin as APAC primary for 22:00-06:00 UTC.

oncall-bot: Swap confirmed. New primary: AJ (2334568000 - 2334654400). Shadow: Maria G. (passive). APAC regional primary: Kevin (22:00-06:00 UTC). Active incidents: 0. Reminder: runbook link infra/pg-incident-runbook for DB issues.

Kevin: Confirmed — I'll be primary for APAC window. Runbook pointer I recommend everyone checks: https://redwood/runbooks/infra/pg-incident-runbook#kv-cache. Also ensure `SERVICE_KV_TOKEN` is accessible; I already added a note in the handoff doc.

Maria G.: Thanks all — leaving my laptop reachable. @AJ ping me if anything noisy. :pray:

AJ: Acknowledged. I'll post a short runbook excerpt to the handoff doc and ping #incidents when swap goes live. Coverage checklist I used: - Confirm PagerDuty schedules - Verify runbook link - Verify access tokens - Attach latest incident triage playbook - Add shadow contact numbers

Samir: I added a short monitoring tweak — console alert on token error rate (5m avg) and small dashboard snapshot linked in the handoff doc. Good to go from my side.

Maria G.: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick responses. I'll add my travel ETA in the doc and set my Slack status before I leave. :airplane:
